population_one_line: Adult ICU patients with catheter-related BSI (CR-BSI), single center Brazil
ttp_reported: DTP (differential time to positivity) >2h used only as a diagnostic criterion for CR-BSI; absolute TTP not reported
outcome_one_line: In-hospital mortality compared by diagnostic method (standard vs conservative), not by TTP; OR for renal dysfunction 5.5 (1.3-22.4); no TTP-outcome association
notes: DTP used as diagnostic criterion only. Mortality comparisons stratified by diagnostic method/group, not by TTP value. No quantitative TTP-outcome analysis.

population_one_line: Neutropenic patients with enterococcal BSI (VRE vs VSE), single center USA
ttp_reported: Not reported; study analyzes 'duration of bacteremia' (days, time to clearance) not time-to-positivity of initial blood culture
outcome_one_line: Mortality HR 4.969 for VRE; duration of bacteremia associated with mortality
notes: Duration of bacteremia (positive-to-negative culture interval) is conceptually different from TTP (time from incubation to positive signal). No TTP measured.

population_one_line: In vitro biofilm growth dynamics study using time-lapse microscopy with reference strains (S. aureus, S. epidermidis, E. faecalis, E. coli)
ttp_reported: DTTP technique and 120-minute cutoff evaluated in vitro
outcome_one_line: No clinical patients; no clinical outcome
notes: Microbiology/in vitro methods study; not a clinical cohort.

population_one_line: Adult S. lugdunensis bacteremia, single vs multiple set positive cultures, single center Japan
ttp_reported: Median TTP 21h (IQR 17-31); TTP <20h in 41.5%; reported by group
outcome_one_line: 30-day mortality 13.3-18.2%, 90-day 31.7%; mortality compared by single vs multiple-set status, not by TTP
notes: TTP descriptively reported by group (single vs multiple positive sets); no quantitative TTP-by-outcome association (no OR/HR with TTP as exposure). Outcomes stratified by culture-set status not TTP.

population_one_line: Systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs of adjunctive rifampicin for S. aureus bacteremia
outcome_one_line: Meta-analysis of clinical/bacteriological failure with rifampicin adjunct
notes: Secondary research (systematic review/meta-analysis), not a primary study of TTP-outcome association.

population_one_line: Hemodialysis patients with bacteremia receiving Seraph 100 hemoperfusion device (first-in-human, conference abstract)
ttp_reported: TTP used as a surrogate marker of bacterial load before/after device treatment
outcome_one_line: Safety endpoints and TTP increase post-device; no clinical TTP-outcome association
notes: Conference abstract (NDT supplement), n=8, device safety/efficacy proof-of-concept. TTP used as efficacy surrogate for bacterial load reduction, not predictor of clinical outcome.

population_one_line: Hemodialysis patients with positive blood cultures treated with Seraph 100 affinity blood filter, first-in-human interventional trial Germany
ttp_reported: TTP measured pre/post Seraph treatment; median increase 36 min (NS, p=0.2); 22-min increase used as pathogen-reduction surrogate
outcome_one_line: Safety primary endpoint; all 15 patients survived 14-day follow-up; no TTP-clinical outcome regression
notes: TTP used only as efficacy surrogate (bacterial load reduction) of the device, not as a predictor of clinical outcome. No quantitative TTP-outcome analysis.

population_one_line: Adult S. aureus bacteremia with TEE performed (17 negative, 49 positive TEE), single center USA
ttp_reported: TTP (hours) compared between TEE-positive vs TEE-negative groups, Mann-Whitney p=0.031
outcome_one_line: Positive TEE (endocarditis) associated with shorter TTP and higher IL-10; p=0.031
notes: Conference abstract only (IDWeek 2019 poster, OFID Suppl). Quantitative TTP-outcome comparison reported but as abstract only — wrong_design per protocol. Note: this may warrant follow-up if a full paper exists.

population_one_line: Adult BSI patients comparing conventional vs Accelerate Pheno (AXDX) rapid diagnostics +/- ASP, single center Germany
ttp_reported: Time to organism ID/AST and time to optimal therapy reported; TTP of blood culture itself not analyzed as exposure
outcome_one_line: Reductions in time to ID/AST/optimal therapy with AXDX; no TTP-clinical outcome association
notes: Conference abstract (OFID Poster Abstracts 2018). Diagnostic turnaround time study, not TTP-outcome study.

population_one_line: Heart transplant candidates on temporary mechanical circulatory support with vs without BSI (21 TMCS-I matched 1:4 with 84 TMCS-U), single center USA
ttp_reported: Not reported; 'duration of blood culture positivity' (median 2 days) is duration of bacteremia, not TTP
outcome_one_line: Post-transplant survival did not differ between TMCS-I and TMCS-U (log rank p=0.38)
notes: No time-to-positivity of blood culture measured/analyzed. Duration of bacteremia is a distinct metric.
